response.justification: The candidate lacks any demonstrated experience with C++ in a professional, large-scale infrastructure context, which is a non-negotiable minimum requirement; their work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no evidence of 8 years of C++ programming or leadership in cloud compute platforms.
strengths: Strong full-stack and open-source contributions with diverse tech exposure
Proven mentorship and workshop leadership in testing and engineering practices
Experience building distributed systems and deploying on Kubernetes
concerns: No evidence of 8 years of C++ experience as required
Lacks documented leadership in cloud compute infrastructure or distributed systems at scale
No experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) in a technical lead capacity
